Hundreds of studies link time in nature to lower stress, better sleep, and faster recovery. But no one had made it easy to track, set goals around, or actually feel progress in. NatureDose® was built to change that.

I lead design for NatureQuant, responsible for every touchpoint from brand identity to production screens. NatureDose is a core part of that work: I took it from zero to launch on iOS and Android, through App Store screens, feature additions like challenges, and the design system that keeps it consistent as it grows.

Challenges

Nature is a well-researched health intervention, but it had never been treated like one. NatureQuant’s mission was to change that: to put time in nature alongside diet, exercise, and sleep as something you can actually measure. As the sole designer, I shaped everything: brand, UX, visual design, and design system, all built from scratch.

The design challenges were:

  • Translate scientific research on nature and health into a consumer-friendly mobile experience.

  • Design tools that motivate users to spend more time outdoors and track real individual progress.

  • Ensure consistency across iOS, Android, and web while keeping the experience lightweight and engaging.

Contributions

Rapid Prototyping & Feature Design

I sketched and prototyped ideas quickly, refining features like adjustable weekly goals, session tracking, and nature-quality scoring for both iOS and Android platforms.

Product Page & Launch Stack

I designed and built the NatureDose product page and App Store screens to communicate the app’s promise: "Measure your nature dose," "Earn badges for outdoor time" (a conceptual feature), and "Find green spaces near you."

Feature Enhancements

After launch, I designed gamified features like challenges, local discovery ("Find Nearby Parks"), and UX improvements for smoother onboarding and daily use.

Design System Integration

Maintained cross-platform consistency through unified typography, iconography, and color systems that aligned with the NatureQuant brand while optimizing for mobile usability.

Juniper Design System
Juniper Design System — App Screens

Design

I moved from concept to functioning mobile product through iterative design and development. Each prototype tested how best to motivate outdoor behavior while keeping data and visuals simple and actionable.

The final app experience combined passive nature tracking, daily goal-setting, and visual feedback loops that turn abstract health research into an everyday wellness habit.

Impact

NatureDose has been recognized as a meaningful tool in wellness tracking, supported by research and partnerships including Outside Interactive.

Users can now set goals, track sessions, learn how "nature quality" matters (via NatureScore®), and see their progress visually. The design bridges nature, technology, and wellness, encouraging time outside in a measurable, motivating way.

Concept Work

Exploratory designs developed alongside the live product, testing new directions for challenges, activity streaks, achievements, and a deeper NatureScore integration.

Future Prototype Screens

Concepts exploring what a more social, achievement-driven version of NatureDose could feel like, with richer challenge views, activity history, and nature score visualizations.

Custom Icons

Conceptual iconography developed alongside the future prototype screens: nature activities, goal types, locations, and achievement markers. Designed to feel organic and lightweight within the concept UI.
